text_block_list.text:
Oh heck, look at the time! I've gotta
head to
training right awa—
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: There are sooo many cute clothes here!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Every piece just screams me—perfect for a cute Umadol style! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Like this long frilly skirt... and this
oversized knit
dress...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And this reversible blouse looks like it
would go
great with plenty of outfits!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
They're all so pretty! My heart is just
leaping!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Hello! Feel free to try anything on!
text_block_list.name: Shop Staff

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, all right! ☆ Now, let's see...
Which one
should I try on first? ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
...And that's how Смарт Фалкон
completely forgets
about training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
